description: This file defines interfaces, structures, and constants for handling chunk-based file formats, including initialization, reading, writing, and searching for chunks within the format.
external_methods: hashfile's functions (implicitly referenced), especially those related to reading and writing.

methods.name: init_chunkfile
methods.description: Initializes a chunkfile structure for reading or writing a file with the chunk format.

methods.name: free_chunkfile
methods.description: Frees memory associated with a chunkfile.

methods.name: get_num_chunks
methods.description: Returns the total number of chunks in the chunkfile.

methods.name: add_chunk
methods.description: Adds a chunk with specified id, size, and write function to the chunkfile.

methods.name: write_chunkfile
methods.description: Writes out the entire chunkfile given its data.

methods.name: read_table_of_contents
methods.description: Reads and processes the table of contents from a memory-mapped chunk file, given the offsets and sizes.

methods.name: pair_chunk
methods.description: Finds a chunk by id within the chunkfile and returns its start pointer and size.

methods.name: read_chunk
methods.description: Reads a specific chunk by id and invokes a callback function with its data.

methods.name: oid_version
methods.description: Returns the version of the object identifier algorithm used.

ctags.name: chunk_read_fn
ctags.typeref: typename:int (*)(const unsigned char * chunk_start,size_t chunk_size,void * data)
